fields.description:
When a document is transferred between organizations, the document history retains the auditable events, which includes all transfer events.  This project creates a new **Control History** table in the document history that consolidates all transfers of the document into a table to easily see the chain of control for a financial asset.  This is similar to the MERS Controller and Location History table that is populated in the document history for SMARTDocs.  

The table includes the date of the transfer and the Transfer From and To Orgs.

comments.author: Pam Baumgarten
comments.body:
Product Approved
Tested on QA3 (26.3+20260427181434)

* Confirmed the Control History table is compiled based on the Confirmed Transfer of Control events that display in the Document Activity History Report.
* Tested the view in the UI, UI download, Certified Print package (UI), Paper Out (UI), eoRequestExport (API), and eoGetDocumentActivityHistoryReport (API).
* Tested Transfer, Pledge and Securitize workflows
* Tested Financial Asset, Financial Asset Addendum, and Supplemental Doc.  The Supplemental Doc doesn't log transfer events at the document level, so there was no Control History table (as expected).  Financial Asset and Financial Asset Addendum had the Control History table.
* Confirmed events sorted newest to oldest
* Confirmed the Control History also displays in a retention copy

There was an issue with the date/time format in the downloaded report, but I am submitting a new ticket to address that.  It is minor enough that we don't need to hold this up.  See more details in the comments below.
